admission.base: No automatic provider login, install, enablement, probe or inference; setup may finish without a model. Every cell starts unavailable until explicitly selected and qualified.
admission.localOnly: No cloud inference or auth/discovery/catalog/usage fallback. Endpoint labels and loopback alone do not prove local execution; verify actual route/executor locality, including gateway hops.
admission.cloud: Per-role endpoint, data-class, credential-scope, hosted training-use and retention qualification is required before construction/send. Generation permission does not authorize classification, images, summary, embeddings or reranking.
admission.transport: Authenticated encrypted transport with certificate and hostname validation on hosted hops and data-receiving proxies/redirects. Plain HTTP only for an explicitly verified local-loopback exception. Route/auth/identity changes reopen admission.
admission.capabilities: Catalog membership, credentials, provider name, compatible label or shared API do not prove operation support. Validate tools/schema, context/output, modality, thinking/history and cancellation per selected cell.
admission.customModels: Release manifest is not a model allowlist. Explicit compatible custom local and hosted identities may pass mandatory operation/locality/authority/data-policy/lifecycle probes as experimental and unmeasured; invalid or unknown cells remain unavailable.
admission.fallback: No implicit provider/model/transport fallback, silent installation or widened grants. An optional explicitly configured fallback requires its own admission and visible identity.
admission.remoteFeatures: File uploads, server-side tools, persistent conversations and remote object retrieval/deletion stay unavailable absent separately selected capability and lifecycle evidence.
admission.credentials: Credential facility or environment only; no values in fixtures, prompts, receipts, logs or exports. Discovery/import never executes command-valued helpers.
admission.usage: Keep provider-reported input/output/cache/reasoning definitions, attempt identity and cumulative/delta semantics. Missing usage is unknown; estimates and catalog prices are separate from measured billing.
admission.cancel: Record local stop, transport signal and provider acknowledgement separately. Closed socket does not prove remote stop or zero charge. No late publication under revoked revisions; uncertain local effects never replay blindly.

codemodeContract.sourceObserved: models lists chat/image/classifier entries; scripts cannot run chat models. classify/generateImages resolve provider+id with session credentials, return stop/error/aborted rather than throwing on provider errors, and add usage to codemode tool/session cost.
codemodeContract.requiredValidation: Resolve provider+id against current immutable selected binding; model-supplied catalog fields and working credentials grant no authority. Inspect stopReason/errorMessage and validate typed answers or output blocks before success.
codemodeContract.persistence: store() session writes and image()/temporary outputs require their own native admission, redaction and base-retention inventory; classifier/image denial must not be bypassed through tools or nested codemode.

fixtureCases.expect: After complete schema validation and durable admission, one tool dispatch with value 7 and original ID; exactly one correlated result. No dispatch before completion.
Local canceled state; remote acknowledgement and final billing unknown; no late publication, completed result or blind tool/turn replay. Count all SDK/host attempts explicitly.
Preserve partial/failed state and redacted diagnostics, original request/attempt identity and observed usage; no completed persistence or blind retry.
One synthetic transport-sink send. Changing any prerequisite to false yields zero sends; unapproved redirect/proxy/downgrade reopens admission. Also pass an explicitly verified local-loopback route.
Admitted generation may send permitted data; all four classifier APIs and the image API remain denied in base, with zero classifier/image transport sends even when credentials exist.
Deny inference/auth/discovery/catalog/usage and optional-role cloud sends, including loopback gateways with hosted hops. No cloud fallback.

Admit compatible selected local and separately permitted hosted custom bindings with experimental/unmeasured labels. Unknown protocol, wrong operation or denied policy rejects; no curated model-name gate.

Exercise each API individually via native dispatch: denied before credential helper/network effect, zero sends and no successful model result. Repeat with an unknown API string; remove each native guard and the independent sink assertion must fail.

Error result is not successful classification, generated image or zero usage; aborted likewise stays canceled. A text-only classifier given images fails before send. Optional success requires separate selected-cell qualification; no base success is claimed.
No stale dispatch/publication or history upload; retain original stream/provider attribution. Cross-provider conversion preserves complete tool pairing and only compatible opaque signatures.
